mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically from -32.9% to -26.7% over four weeks, indicating sustained recovery momentum. This trend will continue, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks relative to the baseline period.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 6.2 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days does not exceed the mean of the prior 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has stabilized near -18.7% with minimal week-to-week volatility, signaling workplace return plateau. This plateau suppresses commuting-driven retail visits, constraining RETAIL_REC growth to less than 3 percentage points over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES change week-on-week is less than 1 percentage point for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES declined only 0.3 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises more than 5 percentage points over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES remaining flat.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has recovered from -23.3% to -13.4% over four weeks, indicating outdoor leisure normalization. This outdoor activity substitution will reduce indoor retail-and-recreation visits, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises more than 5 percentage points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved 9.9 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases while PARKS continues to rise above -10% for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT stations have recovered from -33.9% to -30.6% over four weeks, indicating commuting resumption. When combined with WORKPLACES stabilization near -18.7%, this dual signal of mobility infrastructure use will drive retail footfall higher over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises more than 2 percentage points and WORKPLACES remains above -20%
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 3.3 points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines or remains flat over the next 28 days when both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES show positive momentum.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has risen consistently from 0.9% to 3.7% over four weeks, indicating essential-visit normalization. This signals confidence in public spaces that will extend to discretionary retail, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM exceeds 3% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose 2.8 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines when GROCERY_PHARM is above 3% for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has declined from 11.9% to 10.6% over four weeks, indicating reduced home confinement. When RESIDENTIAL falls below 11% and RETAIL_REC is above -27%, restrictions are loosening; this regime shift will accelerate retail recovery over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 11% and RETAIL_REC is above -28%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve when RESIDENTIAL is below 11% and RETAIL_REC is above -28%.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-June marks the onset of summer leisure season. PARKS recovery from -23.3% to -13.4% and RETAIL_REC improvement from -32.9% to -26.7% are consistent with seasonal reopening. This seasonal tailwind will push RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks as outdoor and indoor leisure activities both normalize.
evidence_refs: fact:Decision date is 2021-06-15, summer season onset
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next 28 days despite PARKS remaining above -15%.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and RETAIL_REC are both recovering but TRANSIT remains severely depressed at -30.6%. If TRANSIT fails to improve by more than 2 percentage points over the next two weeks, commuting patterns remain disrupted, constraining retail footfall and preventing RETAIL_REC from exceeding -24% over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves less than 2 percentage points week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at -30.6% in t-0w, only 3.3 point improvement over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -23% over the next 28 days when TRANSIT improvement is less than 2 percentage points per week.
